request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: acme-001. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: How many devices are running an OS older than macOS 15?","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"question","restated_question":"Count the devices in acme-001 whose latest snapshot reports a macOS version below 15.0 (i.e. macOS 14 Sonoma or earlier).","assumptions":["'Older than macOS 15' means the reported OS major version is below 15 on macOS devices, based on each device's latest snapshot.","Non-macOS devices (if any) are excluded from the count, not counted as 'older'.","Devices with no recent telemetry are counted using their last reported OS version."],"steps":[{"tool":"query_devices","purpose":"Filter devices on their latest snapshot for macOS with an OS version below 15.0, and return the count and the device list."}],"may_propose_actions":false,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
